title: Git credentials stored in plaintext (credstore) — review required
description: Git is told to keep credentials in a plaintext file: git config credential.helper store. Any reader of the home directory learns long-lived hosting credentials. This lexical rule flags the helper; the reviewer confirms necessity or switches to an OS store.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the helper regardless of file protections.

tests.line: # audit: git config credential.helper store present
